limits: No live Podman, runsc, native Windows, browser E2E, remote CI, cloud deployment or live model certification.
External optional tool/database/dependency gaps remain explicit; native source verification is separate from full review assurance.
Mutable registry tags/ranges are resolved to recorded digests/lockfiles per run; regenerations are not promised bit-for-bit identical.
Container root filesystems and review targets are read-only; trusted generation stages have no total filesystem quota.
Concurrent container workloads and cold caches make timing comparisons observational.
gate_identity_note: Gate metadata before the release commit retains baseline HEAD plus the independently hashed changed source; resolve the local 0.6.0 tag for the release commit.
